music_menu.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Main menu theme for a magical wizard school MMO: a mysterious, wondrous celesta melody over soft strings and harp, warm horns join, sense of wonder and nostalgia, waltz feel 3/4, moderate tempo, grows gently then settles.

music_grounds_a.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Peaceful exploration music for sunny castle grounds: gentle flute and clarinet melody, plucked harp, light strings, pastoral and calm, airy and relaxed, soft dynamics, no drums.

music_grounds_b.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Calm magical wandering theme: celesta and glockenspiel sparkles, oboe melody, warm string pads, whimsical yet serene, slow tempo, very gentle, no drums.

music_village.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Cozy fantasy village tavern-town music: acoustic lute, fiddle and recorder, light hand percussion, warm, friendly and relaxed, folk medieval feel, moderate tempo.

music_forest.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Mysterious ancient forest exploration: low sustained strings, sparse alto flute, soft harp ostinato, distant french horn, slightly uneasy and curious, slow tempo, quiet.

music_wilds.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Dark dangerous wilderness, misty moors and haunted marshes: eerie low cello drones, dissonant soft choir pads, sparse piano notes, cold wind-like textures, tense and lonely, slow, quiet but unsettling.

music_castle_a.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Inside an ancient magical castle: grand yet warm, harpsichord and pizzicato strings, woodwinds with a curious playful melody, soft celesta, a hint of mystery, moderate tempo, light.

music_castle_b.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Quiet castle halls and old library at evening: solo piano and harp with soft strings, contemplative, warm candlelight mood, slow and calm, very gentle.

music_dungeon.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Dark underground dungeon: deep ominous low brass and contrabass drones, slow distant timpani pulses, creeping tremolo strings, metallic scrapes, dread and suspense, slow.

music_corridor.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Forbidden corridor suspense: creeping staccato low strings, heartbeat-like soft drum pulse, eerie high violin harmonics, building tension, something huge lurks nearby, slow and menacing.

music_combat.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Battle music for fighting magical creatures: driving staccato strings, bold brass stabs, pounding orchestral percussion, urgent and heroic, fast tempo 140 bpm, consistent energy throughout, loopable.

music_boss.text: Original fantasy video game soundtrack, cinematic orchestral, high production quality, instrumental only. Epic boss battle: massive dark choir chanting without words, thundering taiko and timpani, aggressive brass, fast frantic strings, dramatic and overwhelming, 150 bpm, consistent intensity, loopable.
